description: Read research sessions (each a saved analysis workspace of selected studies and uploaded files), one session, its sources, chronological chat history, a background job, or saved outputs such as reports and slide decks. Set session_id except when view=sessions; job needs job_id, output needs output_id. Follow next_cursor unchanged as after. Job success includes answer/references or output_id; partial remains explicit. Read the existing output before editing it.

after.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous page with the same filters.

job_id.description: Background job identifier; required when view is job.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return on this page.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

output_id.description: Saved output identifier; required when view is output.

session_id.description: Research session UUID; required for every view except sessions.

view.description: Choose sessions, one session, sources, history, a job, or saved outputs.

name: inspect_research_session
title: Inspect Research Session
